meta.extraction: vector (PyMuPDF page.get_drawings(), OCG layers); text via page.get_text("words"); no raster tracing
meta.worldFrame: metres; x = east, z = south (+z south, -z north), y = up; origin = centre of the site.pdf 22F tower rectangle (site page pt 1620.077, 762.686; 8.306 pt/m), same as src/scene/scale.ts pageToWorld()

scale.method: overall top dimension 59000 mm between extension lines of axes a-1 and a-9 (layer G-GRID-DIMS)

transform.formula: x = px / pt_per_m + tx ; z = py / pt_per_m + tz  (px, py = PDF page pt, y down)
transform.fit: least-squares translation only (scale from dimension line, rotation fixed 0) on 6 outer corners vs site.pdf layer ROOF-OVLK$0$C-BLDG-OTLN

registration.note: checkPoints are not used in the fit. "curve E end (tip)" is not a matching point (site polyline ends at the blade tip, plan curve line ends before the blade); S straight wall differs 0.106 m.

knownIssues: DEVIATION: there is no plan drawing for F09. This file is a verbatim copy of F13.json (13F.pdf layout: outline, cores, columns, rooms, walls, 160 desks) with ids renamed; the real F09 layout, desk count and room use are unknown. 9F-11F lie between the 8F sheet (podium) and the 12F sheet; both 12F and 13F-21F share the same tower columns, so the structure is likely right but the fit-out is a guess.

Outline is the outer fin envelope (0-石材断面 + 0-铝材投影 curve): x -31.309..30.200, z -14.897..22.632. The scene TOWER box (+-29.952 x +-13.701) is much smaller: curved south facade reaches z=22.632, north fin line is 1.2 m north of the box; box NE corner is 0.906 m east of axis a-9. Scene tower massing does not match the plan.
South curved facade vs site.pdf outline: straight S wall / curve W end differs 0.106 m; curve tip 1.105 m (site polyline ends at blade tip, not a true matching point).

Room polygons are axis-aligned rectangles from ray-casting around the label; non-rectangular rooms are approximated. polygon=null for: 1#卫, 1#楼梯, 2#楼梯, 9#电梯, 卫排, 备用办公层（160+5人）, 备用间, 外廊, 多功能室, 女卫, 母婴, 油烟, 男卫, 茶水, 观景平台.
Label areas differ from drawn rectangles in several rooms (e.g. 会议室 21 m2 label vs ~27 m2 rectangle; 主管办公室 28 vs 31.5); labels kept as printed, both stored.
C22, C23 are round (dia 1.203 m); stored with w = d = diameter, shape "round".
Desk label is "160+5人": 160 desk modules extracted; the "+5" are not desk modules (12 office tables stored separately in officeDesks).

elevation_m uses the scene formula 6 + (n-2)*4.2. 13F.pdf has no level text. 8F.pdf labels the 8F level 35.650 (35.600 结构) while the formula gives 31.2 for F8, so scene floor heights may be off; not resolved here.
Printed scale label 1:150 is not the sheet scale; scale taken from the 59000 dimension line.
Level: no drawing, so meta.levelFromDrawing = null; meta.levelExtrapolated 39.85 / 39.8(结) is an extrapolation from 8F (+4.2 m per storey), 4.45 m above the scene elevation 35.4.
meta.levelNote: No drawing for this floor, so no level from a drawing.

levelExtrapolated.basis: NOT on a drawing: 8F 35.650 / 35.600(结) + 4.200 m per storey
